Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships targeting brief
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000-$380,000 | Reports to GTM Partnerships leadership (2026) |

## JD Complement
The JD is asking for a partner-native applied AI architect, not a research explainer.
The job is to turn Claude into repeatable partner-led enterprise adoption by helping
GSIs, ISVs, and cloud alliances get to technical close, reference architecture, and
production deployment faster.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic's public signal is not "frontier lab first"; it is trusted enterprise AI with
distribution through partner ecosystems. The partnership DNA to mirror is safety,
control, deployability, and enterprise credibility, then translating that into co-sell,
joint solution development, and indirect revenue. For this JD, the right working model
is partner-led adoption: model quality creates pull, partners package the motion, and
the SA team removes technical friction.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic appears to win when enterprise buyers can trust the product and partners can
operationalize it quickly. That means the strategic pressure is not just model
competition; it is whether Claude can be attached to modern enterprise workflows
through secure deployment, governance, and implementation help. The role solves the
gap between interest and repeatable deployment.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei set the visible company voice around safety, trust,
and execution. The practical stakeholder map for this role spans GTM partnerships
leadership, partner solution architects, cloud alliance teams, product, security,
legal, and customer success. The role should be framed as a bridge between partner
field execution and product feedback, not as a research or lab leadership position.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
The commercial surfaces that matter are Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, Bedrock,
and Vertex AI. The architectural signal is enterprise adoption readiness: SSO, admin
controls, data handling, eval discipline, integration patterns, and deployment
simplicity. The best language to mirror is practical enterprise deployment, not
frontier-model novelty.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic's partnership motion should be read as co-sell plus enablement. The relevant
levers are GSI enablement, ISV packaging, cloud distribution, joint solution
development, partner training, technical close, and reference architectures that can
be reused by the field. For this JD, the strongest signal is the ability to convert
partner enthusiasm into production usage and ecosystem revenue.

## Recent Events & Urgency
The urgency is to convert attention into durable enterprise adoption, not just brand
awareness. Cloud distribution and partner visibility raise the bar: the company needs
partner outcomes, not partner presence. The question behind this role is whether
Anthropic can make partner-led implementation faster and more credible than
competitors can.
